area: git commit default timeout for release-size commits
finding: A 411-file sealed runner commit exceeded the 420000 ms default git commit spawn timeout (ATM_GIT_COMMIT_TIMEOUT, spawnSync ETIMEDOUT) because pre-commit validators scale with the staged set. HEAD did not advance; retry with --timeout-ms 2400000 succeeded.
expectedBehavior: Either scale the default timeout with staged-path count or have release:prepare / runner publication guidance pass an explicit --timeout-ms, so release commits do not fail by default.
evidenceOrRepro: commit attempt status phase git-commit-failed, timeoutMs 420000, startedAt 18:48:29Z updatedAt 19:01:13Z; succeeded later as 5b6b2edf3d with --timeout-ms 2400000.
followUp: Surface the --timeout-ms hint in the ATM_GIT_COMMIT_TIMEOUT recovery guidance.
